proposal.source: function formatTable(_cap, rows) { if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) return ''; const width = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.length)); const cols = Array.from({length: width}, (_, i) => Math.max(...rows.map(r => String(r[i] == null ? '' : r[i]).length))); return rows.map(r => cols.map((n,i) => String(r[i] == null ? '' : r[i]).padEnd(n)).join(' | ').replace(/\s+$/, '')).join('\n'); }
proposal.description: Format rectangular or ragged value rows as an aligned plain-text table.
